text: {"thesis":"Earnings catalyst on 2026-04-29 creates binary gap risk, so sizing must dominate any directional view. Price is only modestly above sma20 (669.12 vs 655.75, +2.0%) and ret5d is essentially flat (+0.44%), with no signals provided, so there is no momentum confirmation to justify aggressive pre-event exposure. ATR14 is 15.94 (~2.4% of price), but earnings gaps commonly exceed 1 ATR and can jump stops. Defensible stops: for a long, a hard stop at 2x ATR below current (669.12 - 31.88 = 637.24) is more defensible than a 1x ATR stop near 653.18, which sits just below sma20 and is vulnerable to noise/gap-through; for a short, mirror at 701.00. Even those stops are not guaranteed in a gapped market. Position sizing: cap account risk at 0.25-0.5% per event, not the usual 1%. With a 2x ATR stop (4.76% distance), 0.5% risk implies ~10.5% notional exposure; 0.25% risk implies ~5.25% notional. If already positioned, trim by at least half or hedge; if flat, waiting until after the earnings reaction is the cleanest risk decision.","evidenceRefs":["close=669.12","sma20=655.75","atr14=15.94","ret5d=0.0044","earnings_catalyst=2026-04-29","signals={}"],"confidence":0.62}
